name: Garden at Vancouver City Hall, 453 West 12th Avenue

conversation.text: I have a 6 x 4 m backyard with a tree in the northwest corner. I want privacy along the north edge and an open centre.

  • an existing tree in the northwest corner — sketched there (the exact spot is an estimate; drag it to where it stands)
  • an open area (open centre) — sketched in the middle, as you said; its extent is not stated

Unknown (not assumed): light; soil type and drainage.
